headline: Bryant and Vermont win again and play on
dek: Bryant beat HCU and Vermont beat North Florida, and they are now the only members with a match still to play, Bryant at SMU and Vermont at Clemson. Vermont are the only member to have beaten Bryant this season.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: NJIT's goals have come at a cost at the back: they have conceded 30 and lost six times, more defeats than Bryant and Vermont together.

wire.line: Bryant have won fourteen matches, more than any other side in the conference, and lost twice.

findings.label: observed

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
